family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF6977, represents the DarT1-associated NADAR antitoxin and related proteins. The DarT-NADAR system is a TA system catalysing the specific and reversible ADP-ribosylation of guanosine bases in which DarT1-associated NADARs reverse guanine ADP-ribosylation catalysed by DarT1. DarT1-associated NADAR antitoxin adopts an alpha/beta globular structure characterised by an alpha-helical core that forms the active site flanked by two small beta sheet regions, comprising two and three strands [[cite:PUB00154386]]. Its structural core is globally similar to the structure of E.coli protein YbiA, a member of the NADAR domain family.
family.name: DarT1-associated NADAR antitoxin
